description: Defines an abstract class SynthUnit for MIDI synthesis, including pitch-to-frequency conversion.

classes.name: SynthUnit
classes.description: An abstract class representing a synthesis unit in MIDI audio processing, providing a method to convert MIDI pitch to frequency.

methods.name: pitchToFrequency
methods.description: Converts a MIDI pitch value in semitones to its corresponding frequency in Hz.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to render the audio output of the synth unit.
